verdict.rationale: Anrok's API returns the tax amount, valid tax ID lists per jurisdiction, and normalized addresses (anrok-docs-10, anrok-docs-11, anrok-docs-25), and it tracks registrations/thresholds across jurisdictions (anrok-docs-17, anrok-docs-18), which are the raw inputs needed for compliant invoices. However, there is no direct evidence that Anrok itself generates invoices with locale-specific required fields (e.g., seller VAT/registration number placement, invoice numbering rules, language/format requirements) or that it pushes a full compliant invoice template to the billing system — it appears to supply tax data for the billing system to render into invoices rather than producing compliant invoices itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of invoice field templates/locale formatting rules, confirmation that registration numbers are auto-populated on generated invoices, and independent/hands-on validation of invoice compliance across jurisdictions.
